# Digital Platform — Public Knowledge Index

This file is a machine-readable navigation aid for systems that consume public website context. It is not a substitute for canonical pages, structured data, robots directives, or sitemap discovery.

## Entity

Name: Digital Platform
Type: AI-native digital services platform
Primary language: Persian (fa-IR)
Secondary technical language: English

## Product domains

1. Digital services: social media and other fulfillment-based services.
2. AI: text, image, video, audio, voice, coding, research, RAG and agents.
3. Automation: workflows, triggers, conditions, actions, schedules and webhooks.
4. Business: subscriptions, usage, wallet, billing, analytics, support and B2B APIs.

## Trust requirements

Only publish factual claims supported by current product data. Prices, limits, supported channels, provider availability and legal terms are dynamic and must be read from their canonical pages or APIs.
